end_date_optional.name: end
end_date_optional.description: If set, only return items with a datetime equal or older than this. The date-time value should be in ISO format. For example, 2021-07-21T00:00:000Z.

force_optional.name: force
force_optional.description: Force delete a destination even if it is in use by other rules.

limit_optional.name: limit
limit_optional.description: If set, the number of items to return when requesting a list. Maximum: 500

offset_optional.name: offset
offset_optional.description: If set, the offset to be applied when requesting a list. e.g. return events starting from the 100th result

ruleid_optional.name: rule-id
ruleid_optional.description: Engagement rule ID. This ID is globally unique across the analytics service.

search_optional.name: search
search_optional.description: Search for an item by name or description.

start_date_optional.name: start
start_date_optional.description: If set, only return items with a datetime equal or newer than this. The date-time value should be in ISO format. For example, 2021-07-21T00:00:000Z.

accept_language_optional.name: accept-language
accept_language_optional.description: Natural language and locale that the client prefers.

message.description: The contents to send to the desired destination (used for all destination types)

subject.description: Email subject for email destinations, also used as the event summary for PagerDuty destinations

to.description: Comma separated list of email addresses for email destinations

cc.description: Comma separated list of email addresses for email destinations

bcc.description: Comma separated list of email addresses for email destinations

source.description: Alert event source for PagerDuty destinations

component.description: Alert event component for PagerDuty destinations

group.description: Alert event group for PagerDuty destinations

class.description: Alert event class for PagerDuty destinations

routing_key.description: PagerDuty API integration routing key as obtained from pagerduty.com (only used for PagerDuty destinations)

token.description: Slack API access token as obtained from slack.com (only used for slack destinations)

channel.description: Slack channel ID (C1234567890 not #my-channel-name) (only used for slack destinations)

topic_arn.description: AWS topic ARN (only used for SNS destinations)

role_arn.description: AWS role ARN (optional and only used for SNS destinations)

target.description: HTTP(S) URL for webhook destinations (only used for webhook destinations)

header_params.description: HTTP header parameters for webhook destinations (only used for webhook destinations)

method.description: HTTP method for webhook destinations (only used for webhook destinations)
